title: Themis
description: What Themis rules, labels and merges, when, and what Jev costs. Docs: github.com/coredev-uk/themis docs/themis.md

panels.title: Last poll
panels.description: Time since the last poll cycle completed. Themis polls every 5 minutes; over 15 minutes means it is stuck or failing (see Errors and the log below).

panels.title: Merging
panels.description: HALTED while a pull request carries themis:merged-unhealthy: a merged deploy failed its check, a revert pull request is waiting for you, and Themis merges nothing until the label is removed.

panels.title: Mode
panels.description: shadow: Themis labels and comments, you merge. merge: Themis merges what passes. Set per scope in apps/themis/policy.json.

panels.title: Open pull requests by ruling
panels.description: Open Chore Bore pull requests by Themis's current ruling: pass, review (a human decides) or wait (a status, release age or reconcile is pending).

panels.title: Errors (24h)
panels.description: Failed poll cycles plus pull requests Themis could not rule on, last 24 hours. The log below names the cause.

panels.title: Merge queue
panels.description: Pull requests queued with /themis merge, in merge order, and what each is waiting for. Rebuilt every poll.

targets.expr: max by (position, pr, title, by, status, reason, allow) (themis_queue_entry{service=~"$service"}) * 1000

panels.title: Watching after merge
panels.description: Merged pull requests whose deploy Themis is still checking (Flux, HelmRelease, Terrakube, tuppr upgrades). Nothing else merges until these settle.

defaults.noValue: Nothing merged is waiting to go live

panels.title: Cluster health gate
panels.description: What holds every merge right now: nodes NotReady, unhealthy attached Longhorn volumes, tuppr upgrades not Completed, failing Kustomizations. A pull request touching the failing thing itself is exempt.

panels.title: Open pull requests
panels.description: Every open pull request: author, Themis's ruling (Chore Bore pull requests only), the themis/checks summary and queue state.

targets.expr: max by (pr, title, author, ruling, checks, state) (themis_open_pull_request{service=~"$service"})

panels.title: Comments per hour
panels.description: Comments Themis posted (solid) and edited in place, by kind.

panels.title: Queued
panels.description: Pull requests waiting for Themis after /themis merge: on a pending check, or behind a deploy that is being checked.

panels.title: Merged and dequeued
panels.description: merged: by /themis merge (command) or on Themis's own ruling (renovate). dequeued: a readiness check failed; the pull request comment says which.

panels.title: Rulings written
panels.description: Each bar is an hour. A ruling is written when it changes: a new pull request, a new head commit, a status turning green, or a policy change.

panels.title: Merges and deploy checks
panels.description: Every merge Themis made (command or renovate) and the outcome of the deploy check after it (ok or unhealthy).

panels.title: GitHub rate limit left
panels.description: Requests left in the current window: core is 5000/hour for the App installation, search 30/minute.

panels.title: Cost (24h)
panels.description: Jev cost as reported by OpenRouter per response (usage.cost). Counters reset on pod restart, so short gaps undercount slightly.

panels.title: Projected per month
panels.description: Last 7 days' spend rate times 30 days.

panels.title: Cached answers (7d)
panels.description: Share of rulings that reused the Jev answers stored in the pull request comment instead of paying for a new call.

panels.title: Jev requests
panels.description: ok, retried (429/529/5xx, backed off) and error. Errors leave the pull request unruled until the next poll.

panels.title: Passed but you closed it
panels.description: Pull requests Themis passed that were closed without merging. Must stay 0 before a scope moves to merge mode (docs/themis.md).

panels.title: Agreement
panels.description: Closed pull requests where you did what Themis said: merged a pass, or closed a review. The bar for merge mode is 95%.

panels.title: Closed pull requests by ruling and outcome
Jev answers on open pull requests

defaults.noValue: No open pull request has Jev answers (none with release notes to judge)

panels.description: P(yes) per question. breaking, migration, data_risk and addressed_to_bot send a pull request to review at 0.3 or more; drop_in below 0.7. Thresholds live in apps/themis/policy.json.
